The bidder shal l submit documentary evidence, wherever applicable : 1. EMD: Submission of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), or valid documentary proof of exemption from EMD, as applicable. 2. MSME/Startup Certificate: Valid MSME/Udyam Registration Certificate ( NIC Code: 95, 9522, 36, 3600) a nd/or Startup Recognition Certificate, wherever applicable, for availing eligible exemptions or benefits. 3. Turnover: Compliance with the minimum average annual turnover requirement, as specified in the bid, s upported by relevant documentary evidence. 4. Experience: The bidder shall possess the requisite experience in successfully executing similar

works/services/supplies, as specified in the bid. Relevant work orders, completion certificates, and/or other supporting documents shall be submitted. 5. Escalation Matrix: Submission of a detailed escalation matrix indicating the names/designations, contact numbers, and email addresses of the concerned officials for resolution of service-related issues. 6. Bidder Financial Standing: The bidder shall satisfy the financial standing criteria specified in the bid and submit the required supporting documents, including financial statements/certificates, wherever applicable . 7. Availability of Service Centres in Maharashtra: The bidder/OEM/authorised service provider shall have a dequate service centre(s) and technical support facilities within the State of Maharashtra. Documentary ev idence, including complete address and contact details, shall be submitted. 8. Acceptance of ATC and Scope of Work: The bidder shall submit an unconditional acceptance of the Addit ional Terms and Conditions (ATC) and Scope of Work (SOW) and confirm compliance with all terms and con ditions of the bid. Any deviation shall be clearly specified. 9. The bidder shall submit a Site Visit Report duly signed without any variations mentioned therein. Note: Bids shall be technically evaluated based on compliance with the above criteria and submission of th e requisite documentary evidence. Bids found non-compliant with the mandatory technical eligibility criteri a may be treated as technically non-responsive and rejected. .
